candidates.prompt: Read only the supplied current facts. Extract every explicitly stated service event without seeing or anticipating any question. Preserve the source worker and employer directions. For active remuneration such as “X paid wages to A, B, and C for agricultural labor,” create a separate service record for every coordinated worker, all with employer X and only the service kind and service period stated in that clause. For passive remuneration such as “A was paid ... for services performed for X,” A is the worker and X is the employer even when the payer is unstated. Do not copy a payment year, annual amount year, query date, enrollment period, attendance period, or another sentence's dates into service dates. A calendar year alone is not a service interval or service day. Preserve an explicitly stated service kind, statutory venue, geographic location, country, and service-specific time form. Leave unsupported properties null. Use undated when the service is explicit but no service time is stated. Every positive record needs an exact nonempty facts quote. If service or employment language is present but its roles, coordination, kind, location, or time attachment cannot be read reliably, return one unread view with services=null; do not report a complete empty scan. If the finite facts contain no service event or unsupported service cue, a witnessed complete view with services=[] is allowed. Never output query identity fields or legal conclusions.
candidates.rationale: Event-normalized revision. The observer directly creates one query-free service record per source-stated worker, including every coordinated payee. Clause-local parsing prevents dates in another sentence, payment years, or enrollment periods from becoming service dates. Conversion validates provenance and source fields, then aligns a native service identifier only when source roles uniquely identify one observed record.

candidates.prompt: Read only current facts and build source service frames. A frame represents one grammatical service construction before any query alignment. Preserve all coordinated workers together: in “X paid wages to A, B, and C for agricultural labor,” workers=[A,B,C], employer=X, and the stated labor period belongs to every worker in that frame. In “A was paid in YEAR for services performed for X,” A is the worker and X is the employer; YEAR is payment_year_context only and service_time must be undated unless the source separately states a service-specific date or interval. Enrollment and attendance dates never fill service_time. Preserve explicitly stated service kind, statutory venue, geographic location, country, and the grammatical voice. Do not infer a payer for passive wording and do not use payer absence to erase the service. Do not inherit a kind, location, or period from a preceding or following clause. Every frame must contain an exact nonempty facts witness. Unsupported or multiply attachable service wording produces an unread view with frames=null. A witnessed complete empty frame list is permitted only when the facts contain no service, labor, work, employment, or wage-service construction. Do not output query flags, legal applicability, or native event identifiers.
candidates.rationale: Source-frame revision. It retains one factual frame for a coordinated remuneration clause, explicitly separates a payment-year context from the service-time object, and expands workers only after source reading. This makes coordination and temporal attachment auditable while retaining the same expressive power and conservative completeness behavior.

value.rationale: Both ordinary-teacher candidates remove query identity from factual reading, keep service time distinct from payment-year and enrollment time, and delay opaque native-event alignment until conversion. Candidate 1 emits one normalized record per worker; Candidate 2 preserves coordinated workers in a source frame and expands them only during conversion. Both conservatively return unread for unsupported service language and allow a witnessed complete empty scan when no service cue occurs.
